- v2 for glmer only (never did 5-fold cv for bayesian models)

## Modeling

```{r}
set.seed(03050321)
splits_kfold <- d |>
  vfold_cv(v = 5, repeats = 1, strata = "lapse")

# check participant distribution
map_dfr(splits_kfold$splits, \(s) {
  assessment(s) |>
    summarize(n_subid_trn = n_distinct(subid)) |> 
    cbind(
      analysis(s) |> 
        summarize(n_subid_test = n_distinct(subid))
    )
})

splits_variance <- map2(
  splits_kfold$splits,
  seq_along(splits_kfold$splits),
  \(s, i) {
    assessment(s) |> 
      tabyl(subid) |> 
      select(subid, n) |> 
      rename(!!paste0("split_", i) := n)
  }
) |> 
  reduce(full_join, by = "subid")

splits_variance |> 
  rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      n_sd  = sd(c_across(starts_with("split_")))
    ) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  arrange(desc(n_sd))
```


### Population Model

```{r}
results_tbl_population <- tibble()
pred_prob_tbl_population <- tibble()
model_lst_population <- list()
reg_coeff_population <- tibble()

config <- configs_all |>
  arrange(desc(auroc)) |>
  slice(1) |>
  mutate(algorithm = params$algorithm)

algorithm <- config$algorithm
feature_set <- config$feature_set

if (config$resample == "none") {
  resample <- config$resample
} else {
  resample <- str_split(config$resample, "_")[[1]][1]
  ratio <- as.numeric(str_split(config$resample, "_")[[1]][2])
}


for (i in 1:length(splits_kfold$splits)){
  
  split <- splits_kfold$splits[[i]]

  rec <- recipe(lapse ~ ., data = analysis(split)) |>
    step_select(-dttm_label, -strat, -subid) |>
    # step_rm(ema_1.maxraw.p24) |> 
    step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
    step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
    themis::step_downsample(lapse, under_ratio = ratio, seed = 10) |>
    step_zv(all_predictors()) |>
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) |> 
    step_rm(where(~ any(is.na(.)))) |> 
    step_nzv(all_predictors())

  rec_prep <- prep(rec, training = analysis(split), retain = TRUE)

  feat_trn <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = NULL)
  feat_tst <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = assessment(split))
  
  model_glmnet <- logistic_reg(
    penalty = config$hp2,
    mixture = config$hp1
  ) |> 
    set_engine("glmnet") |> 
      set_mode("classification") |> 
    fit(lapse ~ ., data = feat_trn)
  
  model_lst_population[[i]] <- model_glmnet
  
  auroc_trn <- tibble(
    truth = factor(as.numeric(feat_trn$lapse)),
    .pred_1 = predict(model_glmnet, feat_trn, type = "prob")$.pred_lapse
  ) |>
    roc_auc(truth = truth, .pred_1)
  
  auroc_tst <- tibble(
    truth = factor(as.numeric(feat_tst$lapse)),
    .pred_1 = predict(model_glmnet, feat_tst, type = "prob")$.pred_lapse
  ) |>
    roc_auc(truth = truth, .pred_1)
  
  results_tbl_population <- results_tbl_population |> 
    rbind(tibble(
      id = i,
      auroc_trn = auroc_trn$.estimate,
      auroc_tst = auroc_tst$.estimate
    ))
  
  pred_prob_tbl_population <- pred_prob_tbl_population |> 
    rbind(tibble(prob = 
                   predict(model_glmnet, feat_tst, type = "prob")$`.pred_no lapse`))
  
  reg_coeff_population <- reg_coeff_population |> 
    rbind(model_glmnet |> tidy() |> mutate(fold = i) |> relocate(fold))
  
}

```

```{r}
results_tbl <- tibble()
pred_prob_tbl <- tibble()
model_lst <- list()
reg_coeff <- tibble()

config <- configs_all |>
  arrange(desc(auroc)) |>
  slice(1) |>
  mutate(algorithm = params$algorithm)

algorithm <- config$algorithm
feature_set <- config$feature_set

if (config$resample == "none") {
  resample <- config$resample
} else {
  resample <- str_split(config$resample, "_")[[1]][1]
  ratio <- as.numeric(str_split(config$resample, "_")[[1]][2])
}


for (i in 1:length(splits_kfold$splits)){
  
  split <- splits_kfold$splits[[i]]
  
  feat <- analysis(split) |> 
    left_join(ids, by = "subid")

  rec <- recipe(lapse ~ ., data = feat) |>
    step_select(-dttm_label, -strat, -subid) |>
    # step_rm(ema_1.maxraw.p24) |> 
    step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
    step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
    themis::step_downsample(lapse, under_ratio = ratio, seed = 10) |>
    step_zv(all_predictors()) |>
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors(),
                   -starts_with("id")) |>
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) |> 
    step_rm(where(~ any(is.na(.)))) |> 
    step_nzv(all_predictors()) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_1_5.recentraw.p0:id_auh_ndrinks_week) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_1_5.recentraw.p0:id_dsm5_total) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_1_5.recentraw.p0:id_yap) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_2.maxraw.p168:id_auh_ndrinks_week) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_2.maxraw.p168:id_dsm5_total) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_2.maxraw.p168:id_yap) |>
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_4.medraw.p168:id_mspss) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_4.medraw.p168:id_dsm5_total) |>
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_4.medraw.p168:id_pacs) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_lapse.countraw.p168:id_dass_anx) |>
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_lapse.countraw.p168:id_dsm5_total) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_lapse.countraw.p168:id_pacs) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_lapse.countraw.p48:id_auh_ndrinks_week) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ ema_lapse.countraw.p48:id_dsm5_total) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ gps_normentropy.raw.p168:id_auh_ndrinks_week) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ gps_normentropy.raw.p168:id_dsm5_total) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ gps_normentropy.raw.p168:id_pacs) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ gps_risk_medium.durraw.p168:id_demo_sex) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ gps_type_aa.durraw.p168:id_dass_anx) |> 
    step_interact(terms = ~ gps_type_aa.durraw.p168:id_dsm5_total) |>
    step_interact(terms = ~ gps_type_aa.durraw.p168:id_pacs) |>
    step_interact(terms = ~ gps_type_restaurant.durraw.p168:id_dsm5_total) |>
    step_select(-starts_with("id_"))

  rec_prep <- prep(rec, training = feat, retain = TRUE)

  feat_trn <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = NULL)
  feat_tst <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = assessment(split) |> 
                     left_join(ids, by = "subid"))
  
  model_glmnet <- logistic_reg(
    penalty = config$hp2,
    mixture = config$hp1
  ) |> 
    set_engine("glmnet") |> 
      set_mode("classification") |> 
    fit(lapse ~ ., data = feat_trn)
  
  model_lst[[i]] <- model_glmnet
  
  auroc_trn <- tibble(
    truth = factor(as.numeric(feat_trn$lapse)),
    .pred_1 = predict(model_glmnet, feat_trn, type = "prob")$.pred_lapse
  ) |>
    roc_auc(truth = truth, .pred_1)
  
  auroc_tst <- tibble(
    truth = factor(as.numeric(feat_tst$lapse)),
    .pred_1 = predict(model_glmnet, feat_tst, type = "prob")$.pred_lapse
  ) |>
    roc_auc(truth = truth, .pred_1)
  
  results_tbl <- results_tbl |> 
    rbind(tibble(
      id = i,
      auroc_trn = auroc_trn$.estimate,
      auroc_tst = auroc_tst$.estimate
    ))
  
  pred_prob_tbl <- pred_prob_tbl |> 
    rbind(tibble(prob = 
                   predict(model_glmnet, feat_tst, type = "prob")$`.pred_no lapse`))
  
  reg_coeff <- reg_coeff |> 
    rbind(model_glmnet |> tidy() |> mutate(fold = i) |> relocate(fold))
  
}

```

### Parameters

```{r}
coeffs <- reg_coeff_population |> 
  mutate(term = if_else(term == "(Intercept)", "Intercept", term)) |> 
  select(fold, term, estimate) |> 
  rename(population = estimate) |> 
  right_join(fix_eff_tbl_multilevel |> rename(multilevel = Estimate) |> 
               select(fold, term, multilevel),
             by = c("fold", "term"))

coeffs

# cor(coeffs$multilevel, coeffs$population)

mean(coeffs$multilevel - coeffs$population)
```

higher variance in parameter estimates for multilevel vs. population

```{r}
coeffs |> 
  group_by(term) |> 
  summarize(
    multilevel_mean = mean(multilevel),
    multilevel_sd = sd(multilevel),
    population_mean = mean(population),
    population_sd = sd(population)
  ) |> 
  print_kbl()
```

```{r}
coeffs |> 
  arrange(term) |> 
  print_kbl()

coeffs |> 
  mutate(diff = multilevel - population) |> 
  relocate(fold, term, diff) |> 
  arrange(desc(abs(diff))) |> 
  print_kbl()

coeffs |> 
  mutate(diff = multilevel - population) |> 
  group_by(term) |> 
  summarize(
    diff_mean = mean(diff),
    diff_sd = sd(diff)
  ) |> 
  arrange(desc(abs(diff_mean))) |> 
  print_kbl()
```


**Compare population level model to multilevel model**

Quick compare of predicted probabilities
```{r}
probs <- tibble(
  multilevel = 1 - pred_prob_tbl_multilevel$Estimate,
  multilevel_fixed = 1 - pred_prob_tbl_multilevel_fixed$Estimate,
  population = 1 - pred_prob_tbl_population$prob
)

cor(probs$multilevel, probs$population)
cor(probs$multilevel_fixed, probs$population)
cor(probs$multilevel_fixed, probs$multilevel)

ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = probs, aes(x = population, y = multilevel)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red",
                linewidth = 1) +
    labs(x = "Population-Level Model Predicted Probability",
         y = "Multilevel Model (with random effects) Predicted Probability")

ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = probs, aes(x = population, y = multilevel_fixed)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red",
                linewidth = 1) +
    labs(x = "Population-Level Model Predicted Probability",
         y = "Multilevel Model (without random effects) Predicted Probability")

ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = probs, aes(x = multilevel, y = multilevel_fixed)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red",
                linewidth = 1) +
    labs(x = "Multilevel Model (with random effects) Predicted Probability",
         y = "Multilevel Model (without random effects) Predicted Probability")
```



## Fairness Analysis


```{r}
d_fairness <- feat_test |> 
  select(fold, subid, dttm_label, lapse) |> 
  cbind(probs) |> 
  left_join(ids |> select(subid, starts_with("demo")), by = "subid") |> 
  glimpse()
```

**Sex**

```{r}
d_fairness_male <- d_fairness |> 
  filter(demo_sex == "Male") |> 
  select(fold, subid, dttm_label, lapse, multilevel, population, multilevel_fixed)

d_fairness_female <- d_fairness |> 
  filter(demo_sex == "Female") |> 
  select(fold, subid, dttm_label, lapse, multilevel, population, multilevel_fixed)

# check if all folds have lapses
d_fairness_male |> 
  group_by(fold) |> 
  summarize(n = sum(lapse == "lapse"))
d_fairness_female |> 
  group_by(fold) |> 
  summarize(n = sum(lapse == "lapse"))

# Comparison
fairness_sex <- full_join(
  d_fairness_male |> 
    group_by(fold) |> 
    summarize(
      male_multilevel = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel),
      male_multilevel_fixed = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel_fixed),
      male_population = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = population)
    ),
  d_fairness_female |> 
    group_by(fold) |> 
    summarize(
      female_multilevel = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel),
      female_multilevel_fixed = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel_fixed),
      female_population = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = population)
    )
) |> 
  mutate(diff_multilevel = male_multilevel - female_multilevel,
         diff_multilevel_fixed = male_multilevel_fixed - female_multilevel_fixed,
         diff_population = male_population - female_population) |> 
  relocate(fold, diff_multilevel, diff_multilevel_fixed, diff_population) 

fairness_sex

fairness_sex |> skimr::skim_without_charts()
```

**Race**

```{r}
d_fairness_white <- d_fairness |> 
  filter(demo_race == "White/Caucasian") |> 
  select(fold, subid, dttm_label, lapse, multilevel, population, multilevel_fixed)

d_fairness_nonwhite <- d_fairness |> 
  filter(demo_race != "White/Caucasian") |> 
  select(fold, subid, dttm_label, lapse, multilevel, population, multilevel_fixed)

# check if all folds have lapses
d_fairness_white |> 
  group_by(fold) |> 
  summarize(n = sum(lapse == "lapse"))
d_fairness_nonwhite |> 
  group_by(fold) |> 
  summarize(n = sum(lapse == "lapse"))

# Comparison
fairness_race <- full_join(
  d_fairness_white |> 
    group_by(fold) |> 
    summarize(
      white_multilevel = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel),
      white_multilevel_fixed = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel_fixed),
      white_population = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = population)
    ),
  d_fairness_nonwhite |> 
    group_by(fold) |> 
    summarize(
      nonwhite_multilevel = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel),
      nonwhite_multilevel_fixed = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = multilevel_fixed),
      nonwhite_population = roc_auc_vec(truth = factor(lapse), estimate = population)
    )
) |> 
  mutate(diff_multilevel = white_multilevel - nonwhite_multilevel,
         diff_multilevel_fixed = white_multilevel_fixed - nonwhite_multilevel_fixed,
         diff_population = white_population - nonwhite_population) |> 
  relocate(fold, diff_multilevel, diff_multilevel_fixed, diff_population)

fairness_race

fairness_race |> skimr::skim()
```
